communes: Oeiras E S.Julião Da Barra, Paço De Arcos E Caxias

blurb.text: A coastal area near Lisbon and Estoril known for fortified wine, a liqueur wine in off-dry, topaz-colored style with nutty aromas. It was once sought after for its tawny wine, but suburban building has since cut it back sharply.
